subject: Whole-game soundtrack identity and reference design
question: Owner-initiated scope correction during soundtrack development
decision: Develop a whole-game multi-genre sonic identity, adding the original SNES Donkey Kong Country soundtrack as a concrete influence and realizing the feel through modern VST performances. Palette, instrument, theme and reference design is a key phase. Opera House, Sky Lagoon and Castle are improving studies but are not polished enough for release. Specific proposed palette choices still require review; the existing UVI-family, protected-media and release constraints retain their scopes.
